main_text.p: re. Charta me potius quàm oratio deficeret, si recen-sere vellem singulos Pontificiæ Religionis errores, quibus Protestantes implicari & inquinari nolunt, ut scil. Summi Pastoris Christi Iesu voci fideliter[?] constantérque obediant, atque obtemperent: quâ quidem nulla potest esse verâ Ovis nota certior & exploratior.
main_text.head: De Catholicis ( quos vocat ) Principibus, veluti Arietibus; quorum duo genera ponit Bellarminus: Primum Eorum, qui laedunt Gregem, Alterum Eorum,qui non adiuvant.
Bellarminus alibi.
main_text.p: {1}Bellarm. lib. 5. de Pont. c.7. §. Quinta ratio.Altera potestas, quæ est Pastori necessaria, circa Arietes versatur, qui sunt Principes Catholici, ut quando cornibus gregem laedunt, eos recludat, & prohibeat, ne ultrà procedant. Possit Pastor Arietes furiosos, & destruentes ovile separare, & recludere; talis Aries est Princeps, Catholicus fide, sed adeò malus, ut multùm obsit religioni & Ecclesiæ. Sic de primo Arietum genere; de Altero adiungis. Et debet Pastor iubere Reges Deo servire defendendo Ecclesiam, & punicndo Hæreticos & Schismaticos, & nisi fecerint, etiam cogere per excommunicationem, aliasque COMMODAS RATIONES.
main_text.head: I. ANIMADVERSIO.

head.i: In Arietibus debellandis infeliciter Bellarminum aciem struere.

main_text.p: TRiplex igitur bellum iam denunciavit strenuus hic buccinator Bellarminus; unum inter Arietes & Lupos; excitat enim Regem Catholicum ad Reges Hæreticos puniendos: Alterum est inter ipsos Arietes, quia Rex innocens debet Arietes furiosos, & schismaticos prohibere: Tertium Pastoris adversus omnes; Eius enim est, I. Lupos OMNI RATIONE abigere. II. Arietes furiosos re-cludere.

page.notes: The first paragraph opens with an ornament before "Altera", read as the reference mark 1, which is printed beside the marginal note. The letters in the first line of the Bellarminus quotation and in the "hdeliter" word of the first paragraph are uncertain, and the latter is marked [?]. The word "Ovis" and other spellings are as printed. The large initial "T" of "Riplex" is joined to it. The line "re-cludere" is hyphenated across the line end and its hyphen is kept as printed. Figures and watermarks at the bottom right and the bullet points on the page are not printed text and are left out.
